 Dileshwar versus State Of Chhattisgarh
 Order Sheet
09/12/2024 Ms. Rajni Soren, Adv. for the petitioners.

Mr. R.K. Gupta, Addl. Adv. General for the
 respondents No. 1 to 8.
Mr. Ramakant Mishra, Dy. Solicitor General for the Union of India/respondent No. 9 and 10.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are resident of village Nagarmuda,
Tahsil Tamnar Distt. Raigarh.

She further submits that land of aforesaid village has been acquired for the purpose of private respondent No. 1, but no compensation has been paid to the petitioners,
no resettlement has been made by the respondent authorities and even then, they are cutting trees.

It is further submitted that as per proviso of sub- section 5 of Section 16 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
rehabilitation and resettlement scheme shall be formulated by the Administrator in consultation with Gram Sabha in scheduled area in accordance with provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996.
